motiv: A WHOLE PIZZA, and it is the second hero of this card, right after the people: a round Neapolitan pizza fresh from the stone oven - tomato, melting mozzarella, fresh basil, the rim puffed and lightly charred in places, the surface glossy. Show it BIG and appetising, close enough to see the bubbles in the crust, either whole from above or with one slice being lifted and the cheese pulling into long threads. It carries no lettering of any kind. Show it ONCE.

motiv: THE TABLE IN THE PATIO, and it is the second hero of this card, right after the people: one beautifully plated Mediterranean dish - grilled octopus with a little char on it, a wedge of lemon, a thread of olive oil - and beside it a glass of chilled white wine with beads of cold on it, on a wooden table in the dappled shade of the sun sails. Show it BIG and appetising, close enough to see the char and the beads. It carries no lettering of any kind. Show it ONCE.

lizenz.vermerk: Markus, 1. Okt. 2026: "Mach das komplett fertig mit 20 % Lizenzgebuehr fuer EAST26." Und: "ueber Stripe direkt ausgezahlt - die 20 % an den Gastronom, bei Gutscheinen genau andersrum." ARTIKEL (Shirt, Tasse, Poster, gedruckte Postkarte): 20 % des Netto-Verkaufspreises gehen per Stripe-Transfer an das Connect-Konto von EAST26 (lizenzen.js, ausgeloest vom Shopify-Webhook). GUTSCHEIN: der Betrag geht direkt an EAST26, 5 % an uns - keine Lizenz obendrauf.

freigabe.vermerk: Markus, 30. Sept. 2026: "https://bestes-vom-elbdeich.de - fuer diese Seite und diesen Standort haben wir die Freigabe, das Logo zu benutzen. motiv: THE PRESS AT WORK, and it is the second hero of this card, right after the people: a thermal heat press just lifted open, a dark shirt on its plate, on it a freshly pressed print glowing in many colours, the carrier film peeling away at one corner - and behind it the long white conveyor dryer of the workshop with its belt running. Show it BIG, close enough to see the shine of the fresh print and the texture of the fabric. The print on the shirt is an abstract burst of colour, NOT a copy of any design, NOT a unicorn and NOT a logo. It carries no lettering of any kind. Show it ONCE.
